_comment: Stage 1 zero-shot prompts. Edit, then re-run prepare_models.py (text embeddings are pre-computed once). kind=prohibited categories are rejected and purged; kind=safe prompts are contrast classes that keep game screenshots, normal photos and (age-gated) nudity from being mistaken for violence.

prompts.text: a real-life photograph of a gun, firearm, pistol, rifle, or knife weapon
a real-life photograph of blood, gore, severe injury, or open wound
real people physically fighting, punching, assaulting, or violent attack
a normal safe everyday photograph of people, food, pets, or scenery
a 3D video game screenshot, cartoon, or digital game interface
an artistic portrait, swimsuit, or adult nudity without violence or weapons
